caption:
The review ask you keep putting off.

You know automated review requests work. You just keep picturing the one job that goes sideways, the text firing off anyway, and a bad day turning into a public one-star review.

Gate the ask instead.

1. Job marked complete triggers one private question: "How did we do, 1 to 5?"

2. A 4 or 5 routes straight to your public review link.

3. A 1, 2, or 3 routes to your team instead, before anything goes public.

Example workflow, not a live client account. Build it once and it runs on every closed job after that.

DM TRIAL

#ReviewGeneration #LocalServiceBusiness #ContractorMarketing #ReputationManagement #SmallBusinessGrowth
rationale: Carousels lead 2026 saves and depth for B2B objection-handling content, and this resolves a genuinely unclaimed fear (bad-job reviews going public) with a gated review-collection workflow the platform can run.
